__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The ethereal knight is clad in shadowy black armor. It appears as though he
was involved in the carnage that occurred here. His soul is trapped here, as
he waits for release.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A dark ethereal knight hovers over the bloody clearing.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle knight ethereal dark

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The old tree looks as though the wind has battered and torn at it for years.
Very few leaves remain. Its limbs are crooked and gnarled. It moans as the
wind pushes it back and forth.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A huge, gnarled tree stands here, battered by age and nature.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle treant tree

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The cave dweller looks like a mixture of several disgusting monsters. It has
a bird's beak, huge white eyes, a furry body, and long clawed hands and feet.
It sees you and snarls.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A slimy, gross creature is here munching on a corpse.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dweller cave creature

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A grey toad. Its about the size of a cow. Small horns grow all over its body.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A rather large rock toad sits here, croaking loudly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle toad rock

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The weeping willow has long thins branches. These branches seem to droop in
anguish and dismay. You hear a faint sound of crying.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large willow tree stands here, weeping.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle weeping willow tree

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It looks like a thin wisp of mist that has gained substance and size.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A mistling emerges from the mist surrounding you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mist mistling

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The swamp wraith is made of mist and is in the image of a great warrior. He
appears to emerge from the mist. You feel the cold radiating from his form as
he nears you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A swamp wraith emerges from the mist here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle swamp wraith

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a pitifully overworked ogre. It is dressed in rags and shuffles along
with its head hung low. It sees you and cringes in mortal terror.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The ogre villager is here, going about its chores.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ogre villager

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The ogre warrior is dressed in thick fur armor. He looks quite large and
formidable.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The ogre warrior stands here, growling fiercely.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle warrior ogre

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The ogre guard stands here manning his post. It appears as though he would
fight to the death before abandoning his post.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The ogre guard is here manning his post faithfully.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guard ogre

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The ogre shaman is draped in thick fur cloaks and pelts. He has all types of
charms and holy symbols draped about him. He looks at you and snarls.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The ogre shaman is here chanting arcane words and waving his arms.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle shaman ogre

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is the biggest ogre you have ever seen. He is heavily equipped and looks
quite formidable. He towers high above you and growls menacingly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The ogre chieftain is here, observing his subjects.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle chief chieftain ogre

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The plains barbarian is clad in heavy furs. He seems used to the chilling cold
and icy wastes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A plains barbarian is here, clad in heavy furs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle barbarian

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The white yeti looks like a huge white snow ape. Its long arms end in long
curved talons and its mouth is full of sharp teeth.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The white yeti crouches here snarling.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle yeti white

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The huge worm is almost 50 feet long. Its huge gaping mouth spews ice and snow
as it charges directly at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr:
A huge ice worm burrows through the ice and snow here. It rears up and
attacks!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle worm ice iceworm

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a rather ragged and cold minotaur. It appears to be looking for a warm
place to seek refuge from the cold.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A minotaur citizen is here, hurrying through the icy streets.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle citizen minotaur

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The minotaur is clad in heavy furs. Beneath these furs, you see the gleam of
his armor.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A minotaur guard catches you trespassing and attacks!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guard minotaur

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a huge minotaur that is dressed in thick furs and armor. He has black
fur and red eyes. He looks quite capable of protecting the city.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A minotaur warrior is here looking for intruders.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle warrior minotaur

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The minotaur stands rigidly before the gates of the keep. It looks quite
miserable standing in the driven snow and ice.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A minotaur is here guarding the Keep of Mahn-Tor.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle minotaur gatekeeper

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The high guard is dressed in blue plate armour. He looks quite dangerous and
skilled.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The minotaur high guard is here guarding the Keep.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle minotaur high guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The royal guard is quite huge. He is dressed in heavy red armor and wields a
huge glaive. He looks quite capable of protecting the keep.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The royal minotaur guard considers you an intruder and attacks!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle minotaur royal guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This minotaur wields a huge morningstar and is clad in heavy crimson plate and
furs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The elite minotaur guard sees you and attacks!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guard minotaur elite

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She looks quite attractive. Her low cut gown reveals why she was chosen to be
in the harem.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A harem girl cowers here in fear.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle girl haremgirl harem slave

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks quite regal and refined to be a minotaur.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A minotaur butler stands here rigidly, awaiting orders.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle butler minotaur

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The ring-keeper is a huge minotaur. You notice a huge ring of multicolored
keys hanging from his belt. He wears huge, spiked brass knuckles.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The minotaur ring-keeper stands guarding his post.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle keeper minotaur ring-keeper

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Gorak is HUGE. His bulging muscles are confined beneath heavy armor. He is the
master of the warrior guild of Mahn-Tor.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Gorak, the Minotaur Master Warrior, is here practicing his skills.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle gorak minotaur warrior master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Darkoth is a living incarnation of evil. He radiates a dark aura, and a cold
chill runs down your spine. He is the master of the Mahn-Tor anti-paladins.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Darkoth, the minotaur anti-paladin, stands here grinning wickedly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle darkoth minotaur anti-paladin master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Tyrgoth is the minotaur incarnation of good. You feel safe and at ease in his
presence. He is the leader of the Mahn-Tor paladins.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Tyrgoth, the minotaur paladin, is here worshipping silently.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle tyrgoth minotaur paladin master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Amyrok is a small minotaur. He is clad in loose robes and emits an aura of
power. He appears quite dangerous, despite his size. He is the leader of the
mages of Mahn-Tor.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Amyrok, the minotaur archmage, is here chanting arcane spells.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle amyrok minotaur mage master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Sumaron is clad in white glowing robes. He is goodness incarnate. He is the
master of all the clerics of Mahn-Tor.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Sumaron, master cleric of Mahn-Tor, is here looking holy.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle sumaron minotaur cleric master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Nasturn is quite a natural looking minotaur. He is dressed in leather and
wears no metal of any type. He looks at you and smiles.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Nasturn, the minotaur druid, is here studying the arts of nature.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle nasturn minotaur druid master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Belrak is clad in green and brown leather. He looks quite agile and thin, when
compared to the normal minotaur. He looks at you with a slight smirk.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Belrak, the minotaur ranger, looks unhappy about having visitors.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle belrak minotaur ranger master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Dorgar is clad all in black. He is tall and slender, unlike most minotaurs. He
appears to be quite a skilled thief.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Dorgar, the minotaur thief, is here hiding in the shadows.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dorgar minotaur thief master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Mahn-Tor towers above you. He is simply huge. Mahn-Tor is clad in the best of
armor and robes. He wields the largest axe you have ever seen. You can see why
Mahn-Tor is the leader of the minotaurs. He is awe-inspiring.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Mahn-Tor, the minotaur grand master, is here looking down at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mahn-tor minotaur grand master
